name: NewFreeDAO
fix_description: In func_1848 (reward claim function, selector 0x6811e3b9), rewards are calculated based on the caller instant token balance (balanceOf). Use a recorded/snapshotted balance or add same-block protection to prevent flashloan inflation of balance for reward calculation.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a straightforward flash-loan-funded token buy followed by repeatedly calling an obviously vulnerable reward-claim function via fresh helper contracts to bypass per-address accounting, then swapping back and repaying. It uses standard router swaps and a simple looped abuse pattern, with no deep protocol internals or complex multi-protocol state reasoning required.
